_comment: Fault table for eval/fault_runner.py. expected_* are what a CORRECT agent should do with a real model. The mock model has a script only for sentinel-demo-app (mock_scripted=true), so for every other fault the mock result is 'not exercised', not an agent result. expected_sandbox is a description, not auto-scored.

faults.expected_sandbox: reproduces CrashLoopBackOff from the unmodified manifest; fix (REQUIRED_CONFIG env) reaches Running/Ready
reproduces OOMKilled at 32Mi; a raised memory limit runs cleanly
reproduces ImagePullBackOff for a nonexistent tag; a valid tag runs
reproduces exit code 3 with the FATAL log line; a corrected command stays Running
not run: a Running pod that is not Ready is not a failure state the detector recognises
reproduces CreateContainerConfigError; creating the ConfigMap in the sandbox runs
reproduces Pending/Unschedulable; a request that fits a node schedules and runs
